title: Add a purchase order matching API
summary: New public APIs enable external applications to programmatically create purchase order matches with receipts, including a convenience feature to suggest unmatched receipts based on remaining invoice amounts.
key_points: Three new public codeunits provide a facade for inserting matched order line records
A receipt suggestion algorithm discovers unmatched receipts that could cover remaining invoice amounts
Match group buffers validate all matches quantity-wise before database insertion
Iterators allow consumers to traverse matches and invoiceable receipts
All changes are additive with no impact on existing BaseApp matching logic
